Vincent Coudron I think I’m pretty aware that Zurich is among the most expensive city in Europe. I never compared Austria to Zurich in a financial sense, it’s just culturally pretty much the same. 
And fyi, Austria really has gotten a lot more expensive in the past two years. I’ve been back and forth to Switzerland for quite a while and prices in groceries in aldi Zurich and hofer Austria were very similar.
